name: compact-reopen
about: 压缩之后关闭会话再打开（同一进程）：一轮 write_file、一轮 todo_write、一轮 create_goal、三轮长文本后手动 /compact、再一轮，然后 close_session，再提交一轮、再 todo_write 合并一次、update_goal 一次（会话从 .jsonl 与投影检查点 .projections.json 重新载入：SessionProjectionDriver 先 decode 检查点再接着套新记录、再 encode 写回，WebHistoryProjections.ts:412-447 等各投影的 decode 决定写回时的键序与形状），最后读一次会话消息。比较最终的投影检查点与读出的消息。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false

reply.text:
## Objective
Keep the long notes conversation going.

## Remaining
Answer the next note.
## Files And Artifacts
None
